float16 does not record an exact half-rs import revision. This revision is
a contemporary source/license witness, not a proven import pin. Its
src/binary16/convert.rs:144-201 supplies the matching fallback conversion
structure, bit masks, exponent handling, and ties-to-even rounding.
https://github.com/starkat99/half-rs/blob/5f01541c72030584f2160816b9b4c7ee45a4b657/src/binary16/convert.rs#L144-L201

https://github.com/starkat99/half-rs/blob/dba6126dd4a7cdb637dc0d8882d30e3818e1d002/LICENSE-MIT
